definition: an affectionate word for a cat
description: In a sunny old country kitchen, a plump tabby cat with a white chest and a brown leather collar with a small bell lies stretched out on a peeling white windowsill with one front paw hanging over the edge. The cat gets up, walks along the sill past a green potted plant and sits upright, looking out of the window. Tea towels and a jar of wooden spoons hang behind it, and a basket of onions, a ball of grey wool and a saucer of milk sit on the stone floor by a wooden table.
